en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. And he narrated and said, Abū Ja’far (a.s.) said:

"Ghādiriyyah is the land on which Allāh spoke to Mūsā ibn ‘Imrān (a.s.) and He confided in Nūḥ (a.s.). It is the most honourable land with Allāh and if it was not so, Allāh would not have entrusted (the bodies of) His Divine Authorities and His prophets to it. Therefore, you should go to the Ziyārah of our graves in Ghāďiriyyah."
